action_taken: Reconstruct sequential C00001..C10000 primary key from 1-based row index
methodological_rationale: 0 full-row duplicates and 0 colliding IDs; all 7,621 non-blank entries (2,561 'C'-prefixed, 5,060 bare digits) match row_idx + 1 exactly, enabling lossless PK recovery.

action_taken: Strip whitespace, standardize to Title Case, map blanks to 'Unknown'
methodological_rationale: Given names are non-unique nominal identifiers (10 distinct Indian first names); mode imputation would fabricate identity, whereas 'Unknown' preserves row retention.

action_taken: Trim whitespace, fold 6 lexical variants (M/male/Male, F/female/Female), map blanks to 'Unknown'
methodological_rationale: 24.55% missingness makes mode imputation ('Male') severely biased (+64.6% artificial surge in Male); explicit 'Unknown' keeps groupby(observed=True) exhaustive.

action_taken: Coerce sentinels (-5 [2,506], 200 [2,453]) and blanks to NaN; add is_age_missing flag
imputation_choice: NaN retention + boolean missingness indicator (no single-value imputation)
methodological_rationale: With 75.35% missingness (MCAR consistent), median/mean imputation collapses SD by ~50.3% (15.30 -> 7.60 yrs) and collapses IQR by 100% (27.00 -> 0.00 yrs).

action_taken: Trim whitespace, Title-Case 8 Indian metros, map blanks to 'Unknown'
methodological_rationale: Highest raw completeness (88.70%) and uniform spread across 8 Indian cities (~12.5% of known each); 'Unknown' avoids inflating Hyderabad (the marginal mode).

methodological_rationale: 50.04% of timestamps are missing/corrupted; interpolating registration dates would fabricate acquisition cohorts and distort temporal trend analysis (M6).

action_taken: Coerce '-1' (2,489) and blanks to NaN; add is_score_10_spike and feedback_score_1_to_5
imputation_choice: NaN retention + dual scale representation (full valid vs. 1-5 Likert)
methodological_rationale: 49.51% missingness plus bimodal scale anomaly: 2,521 valid rows equal 10 (49.93% of valid); remapping 10 -> 5 would falsely inflate Promoters by +266.8% (945 -> 3,466).

action_taken: Validate against RFC-style regex (^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$); set malformed (2,422) to NaN
methodological_rationale: Contact addresses cannot be statistically imputed; 2,422 strings lacking '@' (e.g., user1mail.com) are non-routable and must be excluded from CRM reachability (25.12% valid).

action_taken: Validate 10-digit mobile regex (^\d{10}$); set 'abc123' (2,586) and '0' (2,460) to NaN
methodological_rationale: Phone numbers are unique contact identifiers; removing placeholders ('abc123', '0') isolates the 25.10% SMS-reachable cohort and prevents failed campaign dispatches.

action_taken: Trim whitespace, standardize 5 country names, map blanks to 'Unknown'; add is_geo_mismatch flag
methodological_rationale: 80.13% of dual-known geo rows pair an Indian city with USA/Australia/Canada/UK (chi2 p=0.8888); flagging preserves reported country for audit (A3) without overwriting raw fields.
